name: Mizzen Ventures Limited
about: Mizzen Ventures Limited engages in construction works and infrastructure activities in India. It is involved in trading of infrastructure building materials and infra works. The company develops infrastructure projects, such as national highways, flyovers, elevated roads, toll roads, expressways, road over road , airport runways, light rail transit system, mass rapid transit system, via ducts, metro railways, sea ports, and airports; liquefied natural gas and other petro products; construct transmission lines; and distributes and operates power plants, telecommunication systems, software and industrial technology parks, water supply, sewerage and public health scheme, pipeline projects, and tunnel, as well as irrigation and other projects. The company was formerly known as Jyothi Infraventures Limited and changed its name to Mizzen Ventures Limited in October 2024. Mizzen Ventures Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Mumbai, India.
